# SaneBar

> SaneBar is a menu bar manager for Mac. It hides menu bar icons you don't need right now and keeps them one click away in an Icon Panel or a Second Menu Bar, with Touch ID or password lock, smart triggers, per-icon hotkeys and import from Bartender or Ice. Free and fully open source (MIT), every feature unlocked, no trial, licence or subscription. macOS 14 Sonoma through macOS 26, Apple silicon; on macOS 27 it can no longer hide icons (see https://sanebar.com/sanebar-on-macos-27.html). Made by SaneApps; now community-maintained.

## Facts
- Current version: 2.1.90 (direct download)
- Price: free. Every feature is unlocked for everyone. SaneBar went 100% free and open source in June 2026; former Pro features are included. Sponsoring the developer is optional.
- Install: direct download from sanebar.com, or Homebrew `brew install --cask sane-apps/tap/sanebar`
- Requirements: macOS 14.0 Sonoma through macOS 26, Apple silicon. macOS 27: https://sanebar.com/sanebar-on-macos-27.html
- Privacy: on-device by default. It doesn't upload your files or your menu bar contents. Network use is limited to app updates and a few anonymous app-health counts.
- Permissions: needs Accessibility access to hide, reveal, move and open menu bar items.
- Source code: github.com/sane-apps/SaneBar (MIT). Community-maintained: https://github.com/sane-apps/SaneBar/releases/tag/sunset

## Features
- One-click hide and show (Command-\ toggles)
- Icon Panel or Second Menu Bar for hidden icons; drag icons between Visible, Hidden and Always Hidden
- Find Icon search by name, including icons behind the notch (Command-Shift-Space)
- Touch ID or password lock for hidden icons
- Smart triggers: battery, Wi-Fi, Focus, app launch, schedule, script
- Per-icon hotkeys, icon groups, profiles, settings export/import
- Auto-rehide, gestures (hover, scroll, click), menu bar spacing to recover icons hidden by the notch
- Custom appearance (tint, Liquid Glass on macOS Tahoe, borders, shadows) and custom menu bar icon
- AppleScript and Shortcuts automation
- Import your layout from Bartender or Ice

## Limits (honest)
- A small number of menu bar apps with unusual custom behaviour can be edge cases.
